description:
Cihou Lighthouse at Cijin Scenic Area

A pristine white lighthouse building crowns a series of broad stone steps, flanked by neatly trimmed bushes and a lone flagpole bearing Taiwan’s flag. The cylindrical lantern room, topped with a black dome and encircled by a metal balcony, overlooks the coastal landscape beyond. Overcast skies cast a soft, diffused light across the scene, emphasizing the lighthouse’s clean lines and historic character.

This image captures the Cihou Lighthouse, part of the Cijin Scenic Area in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. Visitors often reach the site by taking the KMRT to Sizihwan Station, walking to Gushan Ferry Pier, and crossing to Cijin Island by ferry. After exploring nearby attractions like Cihou Fort and wandering along the seafood street, travelers pause at the lighthouse to admire its maritime heritage and coastal views.
